abstract: This document is a brief study guide for Midterm 1 that lists four content areas. It names experimental methods, including independent versus dependent variables and confounding, as the first area. It then covers neurons, focusing on action potentials and synaptic transmission, followed by sensation and perception, focusing on absolute versus difference thresholds. The final area is classical and operant conditioning. The guide consists only of topic labels, with no definitions, explanations, or examples provided.
headline: Midterm 1 study guide outline covering experimental methods, neurons and synapses, sensation and perception thresholds, and classical and…
key_points: The midterm covers four areas: experimental methods, neurons, sensation and perception, and conditioning.
Experimental methods topics include independent versus dependent variables and confounding.
Neuron topics include action potentials and synaptic transmission.
Sensation and perception topics include absolute versus difference thresholds.
Conditioning topics include both classical and operant conditioning.
The document lists topics only and does not contain definitions or worked explanations.
